description: Open Data Dunkerque Agglomération is an open data portal listed in Open Data Dunkerque Agglomération, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Open Data Dunkerque Agglomération. The portal lists 175 datasets published by Open Data Dunkerque Agglomération for Dunkirk urban community; the ones about transport, energy, water and digital networks are catalogued as records of their own, the others (population, health, culture, budgets and similar) are outside the scope of this catalogue. Coverage: Dunkirk urban community. 175 datasets are listed in the catalogue that this harvest read; 25 of them are about infrastructure and became records of their own. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure data of this area. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-dunkerque-agglo-fr-portal.
licence: set per dataset on the portal
